chapter.title: MyTerrain Annual Review: Year 1
chapter.introduction: Welcome to Year 1 of your educational scenario in MyTerrain. These results are illustrative and depend on authored game rules rather than real-world forecasts.

cards.title: Budget and Economic Status
cards.explanation: Spent $1,000,000.00 and received $1,000,000.00, resulting in a closing cash balance of $10,000,000.00 with future obligations of $100,000.00. Economic status is recorded at 42.3 out of 100 with 8.93 illustrative production units. Operating payments due are $0.00.

cards.title: Social and Environmental Conditions
cards.explanation: Social indicator is 58.0 out of 100 with 8 illustrative service units and 0 disrupted sites. Environmental indicator is 38.9 out of 100 with 3.51 of 15.49 managed hectares vegetated and 0 cubic meters configured retention capacity. No regional weather disruptions occurred this year.

cards.title: Site Management and Progress
cards.explanation: One new project is committed. West field low-density housing is currently under the Building lifecycle phase, which means it is under construction and does not prove a physical building exists. All other listed management sites maintain their existing uses.
